mfg: Cutting: cut the standard pen pocket from waste.
Set the female studs (x 12) pre-make-up — concealed, left front as worn. Use marker.  Move marker down and mark for one extra row of studs.
Make collar and edgestitch.

Set labels to centre back neck. - Set Tibard centre fold label on top and then care label/ size label underneath. Care label: 65% polyester 35% cotton · 60° wash · tumble dry · do not bleach · 2 dot iron · P dry clean.
Set pen pocket hem. Double turn and topstitch 1.5 cm.
Edgestitch pen pocket to left sleeve as worn. Set top of pocket 12.5 cm down from cut edge of sleeve. Back side of pocket to be in line with centre of sleeve.
Stitch a centre divide to pen pocket.
Bartack pen pocket x 3
Set Tibard label to back of jacket. Set to centre back 4cm down from finished neck seam. Edgestitch all round in thread to match garment colour.
Overlock to neaten front facing edges.
Press front crease.
Join up on 5 thread.  Join back panels, join shoulders, set collar , Insert labels to centre back neck, set sleeves, join underarm / side seam.
Set front facing. Stitch at width 13cm from hem up and run up to neck, 6mm topstitch back neck and then back down front. Ensure fronts lie flat.
Overlock to neaten body hem
Set body hem. Turn up 1.7 cm. Topstitch 1.5 cm.
Set long sleeve hem: double turn (1 cm + 1.6 cm) and topstitch 1.5 cm.
fin: Mark and set male studs. Align fronts and hem. Mark for male studs.

mfg: Fuse collar and collar stand.  Set fusible 6 mm from top edge.

Make and set collar and collar stand: 6 mm seam, 1 cm seam at neck. Follow edge of fusible when making up collar. Use small stitch when sewing and edgestitch collar stand. 6 mm topstitch collar leaf edge.
Press front edges for front placket 1 + 3 cm.
Set chest pocket hem — double turn 1 + 2 cm. Set pocket to left side as worn; use the Bedford jacket marker. Edgestitch to jacket.
Set 2.5 cm pen pocket detail to front side of pocket as worn. Bartack top of pocket.

Overlock side edge of top pocket bag. Make side pockets. Set top pocket bag (narrower pocket bag) to front and create pocket opening (notch = top of pocket bags). 6 mm stitch pocket opening. Stitch side of lower pocket to top pocket bag. Lower pocket bag (widest) to be caught into the centre front placket — align to notches.
Stitch pocket bags to side seam before joining front to back on 5 thread.
Set front placket, double turn 1 + 3 cm. Insert wide pocket bag to secure; align to notch.
Set yoke to front and back. Yoke seams to be enclosed. Edgestitch shoulder and back.
Set OH back neck tape to back neck of yoke, shoulder seam to shoulder seam. Set OH back neck label to centre back.
Set collar to neck and topstitch neck.
Black thread - 5 thread: join sleeves, sleeve underarm / side seam. Insert care label.  6cm up from right side seam as worn.
Set sleeve split. Bag out at underarm seam to form V split. Split to finish 3.5 cm.
Set body hem — double turn 1 cm + 2.5 cm.
fin: Use black thread. Use marker for position.  Mark and set buttonholes: 5/8 blade 15.8 mm. Ensure buttonholes sit centrally within the front placket.  Front buttonholes vertical: neck edge to centre of first buttonhole 6.5 cm, then 9 cm spacing.
Collar buttonhole horizontal, central to the depth of the collar stand, centre of buttonhole 2cm from front edge of collar stand.
Use black thread. Mark and set buttons.  Ensure buttons sit centrally within the front placket.
Set spare button to care label
Use Aqua thread. Set bartacks: vertical to top of chest pocket x 3; horizontal top and bottom of side pockets x 2 per pocket; Horizontal to top of sleeve split x 1 per sleeve.
To be individually wrapped in OH tissue. Set label to front bottom right-hand corner.
